section_summary: This section contains FBI English translations of Japanese shortwave broadcasts from Station JZI in Tokyo from early December 1941, detailing official Japanese accounts of military operations, pre-war negotiations, and the initial strikes across the Pacific and Southeast Asia. It includes State Department memoranda analyzing the precise chronology of Japanese war declarations and broadcasts relative to the Pearl Harbor attack. Additionally, the section covers early 1942 diplomatic correspondence and Defense Communications Board deliberations regarding Tokyo's shortwave broadcasts to Latin America and the feasibility of jamming transmissions received in Brazil.

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 3, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Reports Roosevelt's press conference, Chinese military operations, Togo's ministerial duties, Bangkok talks, and domestic infrastructure projects.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 3, 1941

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 4, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Covers Nomura-Kurusu talks with Roosevelt, Far Eastern Economic Conference speeches by Tojo and Kaya, and cabinet reorganization.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 4, 1941

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 5, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Criticizes Hull's statements, reports Chicago Tribune disclosure of US war plans, and denounces ABCD encirclement.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 5, 1941

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 6, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Discusses Japan's reply to US, evacuation ships Asama Maru and Tatsuta Maru, Vichy agreements, and Stimson's remarks.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 6, 1941

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 7, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Blames US for Pacific tensions, reports military movements across China, and notes British war declarations on Axis partners.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 7, 1941

subfiles.about: Transmittal of translated Tokyo radio broadcast transcripts for December 12, 17, and 18, 1941.
subfiles.from: Federal Bureau of Investigation (J. Edgar Hoover)
subfiles.summary: FBI transmits translated transcripts of Japanese radio broadcasts from Tokyo for December 12, 17, and 18, 1941.
subfiles.title: Transmittal Letter for Tokyo Radio Broadcast Transcripts
subfiles.to: Adolf A. Berle, Jr. (Assistant Secretary of State)

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 12, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Announces landings in Luzon, capture of Guam and Governor McMillin, air raids on Manila and Cavite, and naval actions.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 12, 1941

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 17, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Claims extensive Allied naval losses, British retreat in Malaya, landing in Borneo, and details US strategic resource deficiencies.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 17, 1941

subfiles.about: English translation of a Japanese radio news broadcast from Tokyo on December 18, 1941.
subfiles.summary: Alleges destruction of Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, advances in Malaya and Hong Kong, and broadcast treaty with Germany.
subfiles.title: Station JZI Radio Broadcast Program, December 18, 1941

subfiles.about: Report on Japanese shortwave radio broadcasts in Spanish directed to Latin America on the 19-meter band.
subfiles.summary: Reports clear reception in Paraguay of Spanish-language broadcasts from Tokyo on 25 and 19.86 meters.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 505: Japanese Short Wave Station in Tokyo Broadcasting to Latin America

subfiles.about: Distribution of copy of Asunción Despatch No. 505 to military and intelligence agencies.
subfiles.summary: Transmits copy of Asunción Despatch No. 505 regarding Tokyo shortwave broadcasts to MID, ONI, FBI, and FCC.
subfiles.title: Transmittal Form for Despatch No. 505 from Asunción
subfiles.to: Military Intelligence Division, Office of Naval Intelligence, FBI, FCC

subfiles.about: Request by São Paulo Political Police for US assistance in jamming Japanese radio broadcasts.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Major Franca's urgent request for US jamming of Tokyo shortwave broadcasts directing propaganda and instructions to Brazil.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 14 from São Paulo on Jamming Tokyo Radio

subfiles.about: Referral of São Paulo jamming request to Defense Communications Board with local jamming suggestion.
subfiles.summary: Encloses São Paulo telegram on jamming Tokyo broadcasts, suggesting Brazilian authorities consider local station jamming.
subfiles.title: Letter to Defense Communications Board on Jamming Tokyo Radio
subfiles.to: James Lawrence Fly (Chairman, Defense Communications Board)

subfiles.about: Instruction advising São Paulo that Brazilian authorities might consider local jamming of Tokyo station.
subfiles.summary: Informs consulate that jamming request was referred to competent authorities; suggests local Brazilian broadcasts on same frequency.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 18 to São Paulo on Jamming Station

subfiles.about: Analysis of dates and hours of Japanese war declarations and attacks from FBI JZI broadcast transcripts.
subfiles.summary: Analyzes FBI translations of December 8 broadcasts to document Japanese timeline of attacks, diplomatic notifications, and Imperial rescripts.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Chronology of Japanese War Declarations and Broadcasts
subfiles.to: Adviser on Political Relations (Stanley K. Hornbeck / PA/H)

subfiles.about: Commentary on pre-war propaganda preparation shown in JZI broadcasts.
subfiles.summary: Notes broadcasts show extensive advance propaganda preparation, quoting Imperial rescript and coordination of war declaration.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on FBI Translations of JZI Broadcasts of November 27 and December 8–9

subfiles.about: Defense Communications Board recommendation against US jamming of Tokyo broadcasts.
subfiles.from: James Lawrence Fly (Chairman, Defense Communications Board)
subfiles.summary: Advises local São Paulo transmitters are best suited for jamming; recommends against US jamming due to reprisal danger.
subfiles.title: Letter from Defense Communications Board on Jamming Policy

subfiles.about: Agreement to eliminate mention of possible Japanese jamming reprisals from outgoing telegram.
subfiles.from: Francis Colt de Wolf (Division of International Communications)
subfiles.summary: Records agreement to eliminate suggestion of Japanese jamming reprisals from proposed telegram to São Paulo.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Elimination of Reprisal Reference in Jamming Telegram

subfiles.about: Coordination regarding telegram from Coordinator of Inter-American Affairs.
subfiles.from: John C. Dreier (Division of the American Republics)
subfiles.summary: Requests de Wolf contact John Ogilvie if telegram from Coordinator's Office should not be sent.
subfiles.title: Routing Slip regarding Coordinator's Office Telegram
subfiles.to: Francis Colt de Wolf (Division of International Communications)

subfiles.about: File copy of Department's Telegram No. 18 concerning jamming.
subfiles.summary: File copy of telegram instructing consulate that local Brazilian jamming on same frequency is preferable.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 18 to São Paulo (File Copy)

subfiles.about: Notification of Defense Communications Board decision against US jamming.
subfiles.summary: Informs consulate that DCB concluded local transmitters are best for jamming and US will not create interference.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 25 to São Paulo on Jamming Policy Decision

subfiles.about: Cross-reference note to Chungking Telegram No. 228 regarding radio interference with KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Cross-references Chungking Telegram No. 228 reporting on radio interference with broadcasting station KGEI.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference File Note on Interference with Station KGEI
